behaviors: Reviewed complete saved-layout/session stores and old regression file: native slug identities/collisions, repeated save stability, unreadable YAML preservation and once-only literal-prefix quarantine, global-agent/pane counts, legacy tabs/flat panes, sorting, version stamp, missing load null and delete behavior.

Actual eight-test Rust stores target passed: original17-case three-variant slug corpus, actual saved-state CRUD/metadata/legacy counts, skipped unidentified corrupt file, quarantine both stores with hostile glob names and time-separated polls, atomic replacement with no temporary leftovers, and collision-at-refused-slot preservation.

Selected-filename corpus uses actual native filesystem trees on Windows/Unix, exact refusal reasons and inert public load/delete checks; empty public filename correctly returns the required-envelope error while nonempty refused paths return null. Actual symlink tests cover out-of-store prefix collision, unresolvable cycles, unchanged victim and link after save/delete, no quarantine copies of escaped bytes, and successful in-store alias listing.
intentionalChanges: Rust errors are Result values; direct helper null/no-op responses are checked through the public method envelope with its required-parameter validation. Malformed records without a string name remain unidentified instead of being coerced into an empty-name identity.
review.verifiedCheckpoint: Recovered current compiled integrations: stores8 and config20 passed on Linux. Actual Windows/Mac latest-head rerun remains a cutover gate; no claim that Linux executes Windows branches.
